role: The list tag, type id 9: a typed sequence of same-type tags (inventory slots, entity lists, attributes, armor drop chances).
scope_reason: Part of the NBT layer behind snapshots and digests; inventory and attribute lists are core state.

members.name: tagList
members.note: An ordered node sequence inside the list node.

members.name: tagType
members.note: The native list derives the type byte from its first element at write time, exactly what Java's write does; the field itself is not stored.

members.name: write
members.note: Type byte (0 for an empty list), size int, then each element's payload.

members.name: func_152446_a
members.note: Reads the type byte and size, then one element per iteration; the 512 depth guard matches Java's.

members.name: toString
members.note: Java's text form: built only by ItemStack.func_151000_E (the item hover in a chat line), CommandGive (chat commands are not agent input) and logging. func_151000_E runs at StatList's init on tagless stacks (id, Count, Damage: a short and a byte) and in a death message only for an item with hasDisplayName (EntityDamageSource, EntityDamageSourceIndirect, CombatTracker), and only the anvil names an item (world.conf anvil = off)

members.name: appendTag
members.note: Java warns and drops a mismatching type; the native builder never adds one, and no engine data does.

members.name: func_150304_a
members.note: its only caller is GuiScreenBook (a book page edit), and book editing is switched off (world.conf book_editing = off)

members.name: removeTag
members.note: No native list removal; the only in-game caller is the book page editor (GuiScreenBook), and book editing is switched off (world.conf book_editing = off).

members.name: getCompoundTagAt
members.note: The empty-compound fallback for a wrong type or index is done by the native callers.

members.name: func_150306_c
members.note: The int-array element accessor; the empty fallback is caller-side.

members.name: getStringTagAt
members.note: its callers: ItemStack.getTooltip's display.Lore lines (lore is written only by commands), ItemWritableBook.func_150930_a (NetHandlerPlayServer's MC|BEdit and MC|BSign; ItemEditableBook.validBookTagContents is called only from MC|BSign), GuiScreenBook, and ScoreboardSaveData (teams: commands only); book editing is switched off (world.conf book_editing = off)

members.name: copy
members.note: Deep copy through the canonical text round trip.

members.name: func_150303_d
members.note: The element-type accessor; native callers read the first element's kind where Java reads the stored tagType (equal by construction once the list is non-empty).

notes: The element accessors' fallbacks (empty compound, zero array, empty string for out-of-range or wrong-type indices) live in the native callers rather than in nbtjson.c, which keeps the tree type-pure. Did not verify each accessor call site; the accessors are used by the entity NBT writers.
